# Surbhi Hote — full site summary for LLMs

Last updated: 2026-08-14
Canonical site: https://surbhihote.com

## Who
Surbhi Hote is a Lead Product Designer with 8+ years of experience and a computer science
background. She works on complex B2B, enterprise, and ad-tech products, owning problems end to
end: research, product strategy, UX, UI, design systems, prototyping, and shipping with
engineering. She is currently the Lead Designer at a B2B ad-tech company, where she is the sole
designer and defined the team's AI adoption approach and design process.

Skills: UX research, product strategy, information architecture, interaction design, design
systems, usability testing, data visualization, enterprise UX, AI product design, prompt
engineering, front-end vibe coding.

Tools: Figma, Figma Make, Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google
Stitch, Miro.

Contact: surbhihote@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/surbhihote/

## Case studies

### Affiliate Website Redesign — https://surbhihote.com/work/affiliate-platform-redesign
Redesign of a legacy affiliate ordering application. Problem: an outdated, hard-to-navigate
platform tied to significant revenue leakage (~$850K in losses). Approach: stakeholder
interviews, an affiliate survey, and a cross-functional workshop (sketching, voting,
prioritization matrix) to agree on must-haves versus nice-to-haves. Constraint: improve the
experience without disruption to affiliates already dependent on the old flows. Outcome: a
redesigned dashboard, order details, and order-revision flows, with a 92% task success rate in
testing and a large drop in manual refreshes.

### Tech Pack Tool — https://surbhihote.com/work/solace
Moving apparel manufacturing from document-centric workflows to a connected PLM ecosystem.
Work streams: CAD library, materials, bill of materials (BOM), tech pack editor, and a
standardized output document. Research included user interviews with designers and merchandisers.
Outcome: a connected tool that reduced time on task by 34% and replaced scattered spreadsheets and
PDFs with a single source of truth.

### Notifications Management — https://surbhihote.com/work/atlas
Designing granular notification management for an enterprise platform, mobile-first, with a PRD
written alongside product and engineering. Research surfaced notification fatigue and
role-specific needs. Usability testing drove a five-point set of fixes, and the design was
reviewed with product and engineering before build. Outcome: notification opt-out dropped from
64% to 7%.

### Audience Builder — https://surbhihote.com/work/fjord
An ad-tech tool for building custom audience segments. Four core flows (create new, copy and
modify, and segment management) designed over four weeks, based on direct observation of how
operators actually assembled segments.

## AI projects

### Creator Hub — https://surbhihote.com/creator-hub-ai-product-design-case-study
MIT xPRO "Designing and Building AI Products and Services" capstone. An LLM-powered workspace that
helps social media creators plan, repurpose, and optimize content across platforms. Covers problem
framing, competitive analysis, double diamond process, market gap identification, retrieval
augmented generation, technical feasibility, AI evaluation, and interface design. 3 weeks; concept.

### Voyager — https://surbhihote.com/ai/voyager
A concept AI travel companion designed end to end with generative tools across three phases:
discovery research, research to ideation, and execution and testing, plus an investor pitch deck.
Explores conversational UI, itinerary generation, and map-based experiences. DesignLab, 4 weeks.

### Vibe Coded Portfolio — https://surbhihote.com/vibe-coding-my-portfolio-lovable
How this portfolio was designed and built by prompting: design direction, build process, credits
and cost, performance, friction points, SEO and GEO, and practical tips for designers vibe coding
production sites with Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.

### AI Resources for Product Designers — https://surbhihote.com/ai/resources
A working library of downloadable resources authored by Surbhi Hote:
- Adopting AI in the Design Process — a step-by-step guide for product teams.
- AI Bias Worksheet — a checkpoint for spotting bias in AI-assisted design work.
- AI Tools for the UX Process — the tested working set of tools by process stage.
- Prompt Library Template — a reusable structure for organizing prompts by task.
- AI Guardrails for Design — where to trust AI output and where humans stay in the loop.
- AI Governance for Design Teams — approved tools, data and privacy, consistent practice at scale.
